name: open-claw-local-agent
description: Локальный автономный AI-агент «Конструкт АИ» на Node.js и node-llama-cpp с маршрутизацией на CPU, Plan & Execute и самокоррекцией

scripts.test: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>fs.mkdirSync('reports/tests',{recursive:true}));" && node -e "import('node:child_process').then(({spawnSync})=>{const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test','--test-reporter=junit'],{encoding:'utf8'}); require('node:fs').writeFileSync('reports/tests/test-report.xml', r.stdout || ''); if(r.stderr) process.stderr.write(r.stderr); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);});"
scripts.test:llm: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>fs.mkdirSync('reports/tests',{recursive:true}));" && node -e "process.env.RUN_LLM_TESTS='true'; import('node:child_process').then(({spawnSync})=>{const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test','--test-reporter=junit','tests/run-all.test.js'],{env:process.env,encoding:'utf8'}); require('node:fs').writeFileSync('reports/tests/test-llm-report.xml', r.stdout || ''); if(r.stderr) process.stderr.write(r.stderr); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);});"
